title: Instagram Story Ad Images in Vertical 9:16 | Aidreamcapes
description: Make Instagram story ad images in a tall 9:16 frame: your product in a bright scene, with clear space above and below for your offer. Make yours now.
h1: Instagram Story Ad Images Made for the Full Phone Screen
lead: Get a tall, full-screen product image for Instagram and Facebook Stories, with open space at the top and bottom for the text you add later.
intro: The example stands a white sunscreen tube with a yellow cap on a sunny pool deck, next to a striped towel, a straw hat, and sunglasses, with bright blue water filling the frame behind it.

Stories take up the whole phone screen, so a square photo either leaves empty bands or gets cropped. A tall image keeps your product centered, with water, sky, or wall above and below for the headline or price you add later in Canva or Ads Manager. It's a good fit for summer launches, holiday gifting, and short-term offers.
tip: Keep the product in the middle of the frame, since the top and bottom of a story are covered by your account name and the ad button.

steps.d: Use a straight-on photo of the tube, bottle, or box with the label readable.
Describe something with height, like "pool deck with water behind, palm shade at the top," so the background fills the frame.
Download the image and place your headline, price, or code in Canva or Ads Manager before the story goes live.

ideas.d: Sun care, swimwear, and travel minis by a pool, on a beach towel, or in an open suitcase.
Set a gift box on a table with wrapping paper and string lights in the weeks before the holidays.
The same vertical image runs in Facebook Stories, so one image covers both placements in Ads Manager.

faq.q: Can the story image include my price or discount code?
faq.a: Put them on after downloading, using Canva, CapCut, or Ads Manager. Words generated inside an image can come out misspelled, so it's made without text.

faq.q: Can I mention SPF or skin benefits in the ad?
faq.a: Stick to the wording printed on your product's label, and add it as text yourself. The image shows the product in its setting and shouldn't promise results like protection or clearer skin.

faq.q: Why not crop a square photo to fit Stories?
faq.a: Cropping a square to 9:16 cuts off the sides or leaves blank bands. Starting with a tall scene keeps the background complete from top to bottom.
